start.text: Brenna's Goods. If it once had fur, teeth, or a pulse, put it on the counter and I'll name a fair price.

choices.label: Any advice before I go out?

buying.text: Pelts, mostly. Teeth if they're whole. Meat if you must — I'll salt it, I won't praise it.

advice.text: Buy a bandage before you buy a bigger axe. On the Frostmere Wilds road the wolves are young. The pale ones by the northern rocks are not. Pride is expensive.

start.text: Frosthearth Inn. Stew's on, the beds complain, and the fire doesn't ask questions.

choices.label: What if I fall in combat out there?

fall.text: You die, and you wake in my yard. Your gear stays on you. Below the fifth winter you lose no experience. The Frostmere Wilds will still be there. Try to come back walking.

stew.text: Turnips, salt, and a hope of mutton. It stays down. That's the whole recipe.

start.text: The fjord used to freeze clear to the skerries. A child could walk it. These days the ice argues back.

north.text: Wolves, not sailors. The young ones linger on the Frostmere Wilds road. Further into the pines they run in pairs. The pale ones near the rocks can take a warrior apart.

hall.text: The warriors' hall is still a stack of timber and an argument. No trainer waits inside. Jarl Freya has not named a master — she would rather seal a trade pact than raise a war-band. Until she does, the Frostmere Wilds will have to do the teaching.

start.text: Gate's open. Don't take that for a welcome from the Frostmere Wilds. Wolves have been crossing the packed road.

startTip.text: North, on the Frostmere Wilds road, the young ones are bold and not very wise. If two of them look at you at once, walk back through my gate. The palisade is the end of their courage.

rule.text: Jarl Freya Halvarddottir speaks for Hoffender. The guards answer to her word. I keep this gate because she says the road stays open. Hilda keeps the fire, and Brenna keeps the scales.

start.text: I am Freya Halvarddottir. My father held this seat until he fell. I hold it now, and I would rather fill the mead hall with traders than with a war-band.

choices.label: What do you ask of the hold?

rule.text: Open roads, and neighbors who would rather trade than raid us. A shield is for the gate, not for a glory-hunt. Bring me alliances. Leave the trophies in the snow.

guards.text: They answer to my word. Soren keeps the north gate because I told him to keep it open. If a guard tells you otherwise, send them back to this mead hall.

wilds.text: The Frostmere Wilds. Wolves on the packed road, and worse where the pines thicken. Walk them if you must. Do not start a war I will have to finish.

start.text: Warrior Guild. I am Eirik Stonehand. The hall is new, the wolves are not, and I am already short of pelts.

ask.text: Four wolf pelts from the Frostmere Wilds. Bring them here. I will pay, and you may take the wolf-head helm or a jerkin cut from the same hide.

active.text: Four pelts. The young ones on the road drop them often enough, if you are the one still standing. Helm or jerkin, when you have them.

done.text: The hide looks right on you. The guild will have more work when the hall is finished. Not today.

start.text: Ivar Holt. I forge plate and chain out here, where the heat can leave. Marta minds the counter inside. Buy from me and I will shave the price, if the hammer is down.

first.text: If your coin is thin, take the rusty pieces. They are ugly and they still stop a tooth. Bronze is for when the wolves owe you.

busy.text: Not now. The iron is the color I want, and if I look up it will not be. Marta is inside. She takes the listed price.

start.text: Signe Vale. Cloth and leather. Shamans, rogues, wardens, and wizards live in the cloth. Leather also fits a warrior or a berserker who means to move.

wet.text: Wool, if you can pay. Linen if you cannot. Tattered cloth is a mend with a price, and I will not pretend otherwise.

start.text: Ingrid Mire. The wizard hall keeps its pages, even though no Barbarian may walk this path. The door is open for the day a wizard race arrives.

more.text: Shardbolt and Rimefield are the start. Glacier Spike and Whiteout wait for a higher hand. I will not teach a Barbarian.

start.text: Torunn Ash. Shaman hall. I teach the slow, the mend, and the burn, and I sell the later rites when you are ready.

more.text: Gale Hex is a wind for a pack. Ancestor Ward is the old blood in your arms. Come back when the level asks for them.

start.text: Sable Venn. Keep your voice down. Guile, a knife in the back, and the step that is not there.

more.text: Poison on the blade, and Vanish when the fight has your name. Both cost guile and a higher level.

start.text: Hroth Keld. Rage is not a mood. It climbs when you hit, and a kill puts blood back in you.

more.text: Execution spends a belly of rage. Blood Feast turns rage into a mend. I do not sell them to children.

start.text: Bjorn Pale. Fists, wraps, or a staff. Your snow wolf follows. I do not put an axe in a warden's hand.

more.text: Bear Heart makes the blows heavier. Deep Mend knits more than the first mend. The wolf is yours from the first step.

start.text: Sigrid Holt. Axes, knives, hatchets, staves, and wraps. Ivar next door keeps the armor. I keep the thing you hit with.
Marta Holt. Ivar is at the forge outside. If he will talk, his price is kinder. If he will not, I sell the same armor at the price on the slate.
Sefa Chart. I ink Hoffender, the near roads, and the bay. Nils Reed, north of the gate, keeps the deep wilds. Neither of us sells every chart.
Nils Reed. Deep Frostmere, Whitepine, the Cairns, Rimeheart, and the Barrow. Sefa in the inn keeps the town and the bay. I do not.
Sigrun Ashmantle. I captain the scouts. The frost wolves are on every road out of this gate, and I am short of people who come back. Will you thin them?

wilds.text: Gate commons first, if you are new to this. Whitepine to the east. The cairns to the northwest. Rimeheart is the frozen lake, and I do not send the green ones there.

teeth_active.text: Five pelts, to Old Brand by the gate. He buys them when the task is done, and he will buy more after. The wolves are the work.

after_teeth.text: Brand has the pelts. I have a worse problem. A scout did not come back from the frozen camp up the north road. The fire should still be there. See what was left.

scout_active.text: The camp is north, off the road, about a hard walk. Look for the dead fire. Read whatever they wrote.

scout_ready.text: Blue lights under the ice. She wrote that and then she stopped writing. That lake is Rimeheart, but the cairns are in the way, and the barrow-dead are walking.

after_scout.text: Eight barrow-dead in the Icebound Cairns. When they are down, Yrsa in Sigrid's hall will put a rune blade in your hand. Then we talk about the lake.

cairns_active.text: Northwest, where the road climbs. The Barrow door is farther on. Torsten Crowe is in there, if you are foolish. The cairns themselves are the task I gave you. Yrsa pays the blade.

after_cairns.text: Rimeheart. The east fork of the north road follows the creek to a frozen lake. Ysolde of the Black Ice is there. She is a frost witch in the Shadow King's service. She is not Ingrid.

rime_active.text: The lake, the blue light, the witch. Come back when she is done.

rime_ready.text: You came back from Rimeheart. The scouts will sleep easier, which is all I can promise.

done.text: The gate is quieter. It will not stay that way. You know the roads now.

start.text: Old Brand Kettilsson. I buy pelts, and I buy them again tomorrow. Sigrun sends the hunters. I pay them.

quest.text: Five pelts and the wolves that wore them. Bring the hides here. After that I will still buy whatever you skin.

start.text: Yrsa. I upgrade what Sigrid forges and what the cairns leave behind. Iron ore from Whitepine, if you have it. I pay.

reward.text: Eight barrow-dead. I said I would cut a rune blade for that count. The cairn-iron is on the bench.

after.text: The blade is yours. Ore is still welcome. The runes were the once.

start.text: Hjorvin. I sing in Freya's hall. The jarl would rather I fill the benches than start a war, so the songs are about roads, not crowns.

king.text: A name the north uses when the cold acts like it has a master. Ysolde of the Black Ice is said to serve him. Ingrid Mire, in the wizard hall, is a different woman. Do not mix the two if you like your teeth.

grey.text: Greymaw walks the north meadow. A wolf big enough to have a name. The hide, if it comes off, turns weather that should have turned you.

lake.text: Rimeheart is the frozen lake at the end of the east fork. Scouts talk about blue light under the ice. I have not gone to see it. I am paid to sing, not to drown.
